intro: This public analysis report explains the biggest gluten risks in Hushpuppy-mix and how to order more safely.

verdict.summary: Hushpuppy mix often contains cornmeal, which is gluten-free, but may also include wheat flour or be processed in facilities that handle gluten-containing grains, leading to cross-contamination risks. Care should be taken to ensure that all ingredients are certified gluten-free.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.
